transcript: Speaker A: మనం ఏ మొక్క నాటుతున్నాం? [What plant are we planting?] Speaker A: We planting neem's tree. Speaker B: Hahaha! We planting కాదు, We are planting a neem tree అనాలి. [Hahaha! Already over a crore people are learning English through MySivi.] Speaker A: వావ్! ఎలా జాయిన్ అవ్వాలి? [Wow! How to join?] Speaker B: MySivi యాప్ ఇన్స్టాల్ చేసుకోండి, సైన్ అయ్యి ఈరోజే మీ ఇంగ్లీష్ జర్నీని ప్రారంభించండి. [Install the MySivi app, sign up, and start your English journey today.]

summary: An AI robot corrects a man's English grammar mistakes while they plant a tree together. The robot introduces the MySivi app as a personal AI English teacher that helps users translate Telugu thoughts into natural English with just 15 minutes of daily practice. The ad concludes with a special 1-rupee trial offer and a call to action to download the app.
